title: Extract one evidence-backed candidate from a same-document HTML matrix and exact prose
objective: Extend the generic HTML adapter so a trusted static profile can uniquely select a production-shaped table by normalized headers, pivot one tier column into one candidate, and add facts only when exact normalized assertions occur in the same captured HTML document.
in_scope: apps/api/app/ingest/adapters/__init__.py when required to export generic profile types
generic unit and PostgreSQL integration tests
a byte-minimized provenance-sidecar-backed production-shape HTML fixture
out_of_scope_zero_diff: production Vercel extraction profiles or sources
publisher, classifier, and quota parser behavior
fetch MIME policy and Markdown support
promotion or merge of the draft pull request
acceptance_criteria: A1: Legacy table-id/table-class row profiles preserve their existing candidate facts, evidence selectors, validation behavior, hashes, and first-match semantics byte-for-byte.

A2: A header-signature profile normalizes case and whitespace, matches required headers without relying on id/class or header order, requires exactly one matching table, and rejects zero or multiple matches actionably.

A3: Matrix mode uniquely resolves the metric-label and selected tier columns, maps exact normalized required row labels into one candidate, preserves selected cell wording and qualifiers, and rejects missing/duplicate columns, missing/duplicate rows, ragged rows, unknown undeclared rows, and conflicting field values.

A4: Trusted static exact assertions support title, heading, and document-block scopes; facts are emitted only for unique exact normalized matches in the same document, while required drift/missing, duplicate, scope mismatch, conflicting mappings, HTML-entity/whitespace edge cases, and substring/near-match attacks fail closed.

A5: Matrix cells and assertions compose one deterministic same-document candidate whose evidence entries identify the exact field, table row/tier cell, or matched text; identical input/profile produces identical facts, evidence order, candidate identity, and content hash.

A6: A byte-minimized fixture derived from the current official Vercel Sandbox pricing HTML shape retains sibling tables, stable headers, the Hobby tier, the three required quota rows, exact same-document free/no-charge/pause/reset prose, title/H1 identity, no synthetic table id, and an honest capture sidecar with every retained phrase traceable to the canonical page.

A7: The fixture candidate leaves requires_card and other absent material conditions unknown; a real PostgreSQL scan persists one candidate with official evidence locations, and the unchanged publication gate creates no Offer, OfferVersion, or Quota while producing its existing review/withhold result.

A8: Tests prove no second document or source-set API can contribute facts, old synthetic ids are not selected, hashed class changes are irrelevant, deterministic ordering/hash holds, and mutations A-E all turn the relevant tests red.
A9: Manual live control fetches the canonical official page under robots/ToS review, runs the generic profile against current bytes without committing them, and records the exact structural result.

A10: No production Vercel config/profile, MIME policy, Markdown path, publisher/classifier/parser, model/migration, dependency/workflow, feature-ledger, or cross-document composition change is introduced.
verification_plan: Restore the repository-owned environment after the missing-test-runner baseline failure, then rerun focused legacy and new HTML adapter tests.
Run focused fixture/capture tests and real-PostgreSQL scan/publication integration tests against an isolated PostgreSQL 16 instance.
Run the full real-PostgreSQL pytest suite and require exactly two stack-health skips.
Run scripts/check.ps1 -NodeAudit and require all Python, formatting, lint, secret, and dependency checks to pass.
Run manual live structural control against the canonical Vercel Sandbox pricing page and do not commit uncontrolled live bytes.
Run external mutations A-E, restoring each mutation before continuing.
Commission a fresh Level-2 evaluator to inspect extraction, evidence/database state, gate behavior, adversarial controls, scope, and live-source proof.
Push a focused commit, open a draft pull request on the first push, verify all five PR checks green, and leave F008 passes false.
mutation_plan: M-A: select the first header-signature match instead of requiring uniqueness; duplicate-table test must fail.
M-B: emit one matrix candidate per metric row instead of one pivoted candidate; exact candidate-count test must fail.
M-C: emit a required asserted fact unconditionally when its source text is absent; drift/missing assertion test must fail.
M-D: replace exact normalized assertion equality with substring matching; malicious near-match test must fail.
M-E: accept duplicate required metric rows or facts supplied by a second document; duplicate-row/same-document isolation test must fail.
data_implications: No migration or schema change. Existing Candidate and Evidence rows are sufficient because the adapter emits one EvidenceLocation per fact with a deterministic field-specific selector; a real PostgreSQL test must prove those rows persist.
security_privacy: No secrets, credentials, user-controlled regex, new network path, or cross-document API. Assertions are trusted static profile data and use exact normalized equality only. Live retrieval is a manual owner-authorized control outside CI.
portability: Standard-library HTML parsing only; no new dependency or managed service. PostgreSQL 16 is isolated test infrastructure and remains the existing mandatory stateful service.
z0_risk: High product-truth sensitivity. The fixture must not emit requires_card=false or guess any absent material fact. Unknown material conditions must keep publication reviewed/withheld and prevent a Z0 offer.
known_boundary: Full Vercel P2 remains incomplete. This slice is generic infrastructure only and never composes facts across documents.
